label: Quest
description: Enraged Spirits is an Alliance quest given by Kaela Shadowspear in the Stonetalon Mountains. After the Venture Company laid waste to the Charred Vale…
intro: Enraged Spirits is an Alliance quest given by Kaela Shadowspear in the Stonetalon Mountains. After the Venture Company laid waste to the Charred Vale with fire and heavy machinery, furious fire elementals broke free and overran the blighted basin. Alliance champions are asked to quell these roaming spirits of flame and stone so the wounded land might one day heal under Elune's grace.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I'm unsure what the Venture Co. Did to the Vale, but it's obvious they were overpowered by the creatures there.
They set the forest aflame, and used their inventions of destruction to decimate as much of the Vale as possible.
But in their ignorance they also released something else: burning spirits, elementals of flame, stone and rage.
The land has no chance to see Elune's smile while these creatures roam free.
Bring me their smoldering embers to show you've reduced their numbers.

clips.title: Progress
paras: The first time I saw the Charred Vale I almost wept, friend.

clips.title: Completion
paras: The remains of our enemy... Your strength serves us well, friend. Thank you.
